params.prompt: Korean webtoon / instatoon 2D illustration style for a mobile app ad, square 1:1: clean bold dark outlines, flat cel shading with soft gradients, bright saturated colors, expressive cute cartoon. NOT 3D. STRICT COMPOSITION: all characters and objects are in the LOWER part: their top edge below 36% of the image height, bottom around 86%. Upper 34% only background. No money, no coins, no logos. Draw the mascot from the reference image as a 2D webtoon character (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair, round peach face with rosy cheeks, red sweater with white letter M). Scene: a large cartoon smartphone, screen facing viewer, showing a realistic Korean insurance app screen (clean UI) with these exact Korean texts only: top title '내 보장 현황'; four list rows with labels '실손의료비', '암 진단비', '뇌·심장 진단비', '수술비'; rows 1, 2 and 4 have a small green pill badge '보장중'; row 3 has a red pill badge '확인 필요' and a red dashed outline; at the bottom of the screen a red rounded button '보장분석 결과 보기'. A red notification badge with an exclamation mark symbol on the phone's top right corner. Meri stands beside the phone pointing at the red row with a wink and sparkles. Background: 2D illustrated soft sky-blue to lilac gradient with fluffy clouds and sparkles.
